Solution 1[edit]

Let and center be such that . Suppose the length of the side of is . Noticing that , we suspect that is a cyclic quadrilateral. A quadrilateral is cyclic if and only if Ptolemy's Theorem holds true: \begin{align} OA\cdot CB+ OB \cdot AC &\overset{?}{=} OC \cdot AB\\ 1\cdot s + 2\cdot s &= 3\cdot s. \end{align} Because Ptolemy's is true, is cyclic. By properties of cyclic quadrilaterals, . Applying Law of Cosines on , we get \begin{align} s^2 &= 1^2 + 2^2 - 2 \cdot 1 \cdot 2 \cdot \cos{120^{\circ}}\\ &= 1 + 4 + 2 = \boxed{7}. \end{align}
